name: Radial Text Reveal
description: Paragraph that materializes upward through a radial gradient mask, with a blurred glowing color bleed layer that fades out as the real text settles in.
contents: Centered paragraph block rendered in three stacked layers (spacer, glow, reveal)
behavior: Plays once on mount after the delay
A radial mask sweeps upward to reveal the text while a blurred colored duplicate glows behind it
Line height compresses briefly during the reveal then settles
editableByProps: Text content, timing, glow color, color scheme, font, size, text color and block width

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the reveal sweep distance or glow start position

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Font is not loaded by the component, the host must provide it
Needs a browser with @property and container query units support
Animation plays once on mount, remount to replay
